SEARCH
Package neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi

Class Dexpi20ProcessModelPackageRevisionImpact

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi.Dexpi20ProcessModelPackageRevisionImpact
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class Dexpi20ProcessModelPackageRevisionImpact extends Object implements Serializable
Deterministic revision-impact evidence between two valid assessed multi-area DEXPI Process packages.

The comparison operates only on immutable snapshots returned by Dexpi20ProcessModelPackageReader. It distinguishes exact package-byte changes, per-area native DEXPI Process document changes, stable area-identity changes, and plant-wide material, energy, or signal connection changes. It does not reconstruct or execute a process model, infer native whole-plant DEXPI relationships, approve a drawing, or determine fitness for construction.
